semantic_controls.typed_authority: Only matching armed-budget identity plus an actual exhausted or unavailable measurement repoll can become stopped or DIVE-R0002; foreign, stale, duplicate and unexhausted interruption payloads fail closed.
semantic_controls.owner_and_workers: Scoped controls are thread-owned and restore prior registrations; worker capabilities remain active during owner-only diagnostic reconstruction.
semantic_controls.catch_boundaries: BagIn, Copies, AntiFunction, default enumerated membership and provider conversion preserve typed non-evaluation errors rather than swallowing interruption.
semantic_controls.quiet_operations: Existing infallible equality/ordering/hash normalization units defer interruption. They must not poison deferred-set equality or structural hash caches with partial false results.
semantic_controls.diagnostic_precedence: A genuine deciding invariant/error keeps its existing reconstruction priority, while ordinary predicate evaluation remains controlled.

bounded_native_control.qualification: Shared-host functional stop controls, not agreement, throughput, true-peak or quiet-wall-clock observations. Stopped.elapsed_ms and outer report elapsed_ms are distinct observed fields.
